evidence_gaps: Fresh-within-two-hours runtime forensics are unavailable; evidence.json reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS with generated_epoch 0.
No fresh per-strategy, per-chain realised money-weighted net P&L after every fee, impact, slippage, gas/priority fee, and failed-attempt cost.
No reconciled attribution separating STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures while charging incurred failure costs.
No Solana decision-time round-trip quote, sellability, liquidity, latency-deterioration, and simulated-landing dataset at intended size.
No EVM quote-to-block realised counterfactuals or reconciled revert/replacement transaction costs by route and chain.
No out-of-sample regime coverage, drawdown, capital exposure duration, confidence intervals, or sample-independence analysis.
No evidence of cost-field completeness or reconciliation against wallet deltas and execution receipts.

Before promotion, require fresh sanitised runtime evidence within two hours, complete chain-specific cost reconciliation, positive out-of-sample money-weighted net P&L and profit factor, bounded drawdown, stable results across regimes, acceptable execution-failure rates, and explicit human approval.

proposals.downside_risk: More conservative accounting may reduce apparent performance and extend observation periods; attribution rules can be wrong until reconciled against receipts.

evidence.detail: record_window stores fees and slippage, but has no explicit gas/priority fee, price-impact, failed-execution cost, rent opportunity-cost, or capital-at-risk fields.
Default net profit is gross_profit minus gross_loss, fees, and slippage only.
Promotion-candidate logic uses aggregate net profit and gross profit factor without money-weighted return, exposure duration, chain segmentation, or failure-cost completeness checks.
Solana receipts already expose network/base/priority/Jito/platform fees, rent flows, impact, and execution P&L that a SHADOW research ledger could consume.

proposals.expected_effect: Comparable capital- and time-aware net returns by strategy and chain, with promotion blocked whenever cost coverage or failure attribution is incomplete.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 independent windows, 100 eligible attempts per chain, and complete cost reconciliation for at least 95% of attempts; report money-weighted net P&L, drawdown, and STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE counts separately.
proposals.rationale: Aggregate nominal profit can favor larger or longer-exposed positions and can overstate edge when failed attempts or chain-specific costs are omitted. Classification should identify STRATEGY/MARKET losses separately from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures, while the latter's paid fees and adverse inventory effects remain charged economically.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay SHADOW windows with immutable per-attempt notional, exposure time, realised proceeds, DEX/platform fees, EVM gas, Solana base/priority/Jito fees, measured impact/slippage, refundable rent separated from permanent cost, and failed-attempt costs. Stop and mark the window invalid if ledger net differs from wallet/receipt reconciliation beyond 1 basis point of deployed notional or if any failure is unclassified.
proposals.strategy: Strategy Lab evaluation and lifecycle governance

proposals.downside_risk: Quote sampling may hit rate limits and remain optimistic relative to landing; synthetic exits can misrepresent toxic-flow and inventory risk.

evidence.detail: The Solana adapter explicitly leaves gross edge, liquidity, sellability, fees, slippage, and impact at zero and marks outcomes unavailable.
Each Solana observation is tagged needs_quote_feature_adapter and current_edge_proven=false.
Common eligibility requires positive cost-adjusted edge plus liquidity, sellability, and quote freshness, so current Solana observations correctly fail closed.

proposals.expected_effect: Falsifiable Solana strategy evidence without weakening existing sellability, liquidity, simulation, or execution protections.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 300 observations across 30 independent hourly windows, 100 eligible round-trip simulations, multiple liquidity regimes, and zero missing sellability or cost components. Promotion additionally requires fresh realised out-of-sample receipts, which are not present.
proposals.rationale: Leader history is not an executable future edge. Solana needs decision-time entry and exit quotes, route liquidity/sellability, impact, platform fee, priority/Jito fee, latency deterioration, and failure probability measured at the intended size.
proposals.shadow_test: For every candidate, timestamp an entry quote and executable unwind quote at identical intended size, then re-quote at decision latency and record simulated landing/failure. Compute net edge after platform fee, measured impact, slippage, base/priority/Jito fees, account costs, and empirical failure-cost reserve. Stop the hypothesis after 100 eligible observations if reconciled net is non-positive, profit factor is at most 1, quote-to-requote deterioration consumes the edge, or sellability cannot be proven.

proposals.downside_risk: Counterfactual outcomes are sensitive to sampling latency and block selection; conservative failure reserves may reject marginal but real opportunities.

evidence.detail: EVM features deduct estimated gas, builder fees, slippage reserve, price impact, and latency reserve and require quote, simulation, liquidity, sellability, and route approval.
The module correctly states that quote simulations are not promotion evidence.
quote_simulated_net is derived from the signal's expected net-edge basis points rather than a later realised counterfactual outcome.
EVM cycle simulation reserves gas and minimum profit and performs mandatory pre-broadcast simulation, providing a sound fail-closed execution boundary.

proposals.expected_effect: Separates genuine STRATEGY/MARKET decay from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE losses and prevents simulated edge from being mistaken for realised profitability.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 eligible opportunities, 50 independent blocks and 30 hourly windows per EVM chain/route family, including congested periods; promotion requires reconciled realised out-of-sample executions unavailable in current evidence.
proposals.rationale: EVM architecture estimates executable economics conservatively, but durable edge requires later outcome capture including base-fee changes, priority fees, reverts, replacement transactions, stale quotes, and opportunity decay.
proposals.shadow_test: Persist decision-block quote and exact transaction simulation, then observe the next executable block outcome and charge realised-equivalent gas, priority fee, builder payment, impact, slippage, revert/replacement costs, and failure probability. Compare by route and chain against an abstain baseline. Stop any route hypothesis when rolling money-weighted net P&L is non-positive, cost coverage falls below 95%, or EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures exceed 5% without a separately validated mitigation.

proposals.downside_risk: False negatives and lower participation during volatile or congested markets.

evidence.detail: All SHADOW strategies require positive net edge, adequate liquidity and sellability, and fresh quotes.
EVM rebuilds and simulates the exact transaction immediately before signing and rejects insufficient gas-adjusted net edge.
Solana validates impact plus slippage and applies stricter multi-hop limits.
Solana caps base, priority/MEV, and platform-fee equivalents using trade value and expected edge.

proposals.expected_effect: Avoids negative-executable-edge trades and limits losses caused by stale state, excessive impact, fees, or unsellable assets.
proposals.minimum_observation: Thirty independent windows and 200 rejected opportunities per chain with complete counterfactual cost and failure data before considering any threshold change.
proposals.rationale: These controls embody the required abstention rule and chain-specific economics. No architectural evidence justifies weakening them to increase trade count.
proposals.shadow_test: Record every rejected opportunity and its later fully costed counterfactual. Retain gates unless at least 200 rejected observations per chain show statistically stable positive money-weighted net P&L under the same executable sizing and failure assumptions. Stop immediately if any proposed relaxation admits an unsellable route or negative net edge.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any current strategy to CANARY or LIVE.
rejected_ideas.reason: Runtime forensics are missing and the available architecture contains no fresh realised out-of-sample profitability evidence.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase participation or lower edge, liquidity, sellability, freshness, simulation, or fee thresholds to generate more trades.
rejected_ideas.reason: This would optimise activity or win count rather than durable executable net P&L and could admit negative-edge trades.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat leader win ratio or historical positive trades as current Solana edge.
rejected_ideas.reason: The repository correctly identifies that leader events lack contemporaneous executable round-trip economics.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat quote/simulation-positive EVM observations as realised promotion evidence.
rejected_ideas.reason: They do not capture landing failures, state movement, replacement costs, or realised proceeds.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository generally fails closed and separates SHADOW research from signing, but its Strategy Lab accounting and promotion-candidate evaluation do not yet prove durable money-weighted net P&L. Runtime forensics are missing, so no strategy is claimed profitable, canary-ready, or live-ready. Solana currently lacks contemporaneous executable-edge SHADOW inputs; EVM has quote/simulation economics but not realised out-of-sample outcomes. Execution/infrastructure failures must be reported separately from strategy/market losses while still charging all economically incurred failure costs to net P&L.
